headline: Nevish Line Cools as Weathered Expanse and Mooring County Flare Anew
war_summary: The storm on the Nevish Line has spent itself: flag movements that numbered two-score at our last writing dwindled to a pair in the closing hours, the casualty ledgers there ebb, and all eight strongpoints remain Warden-held. Mooring County, still in our last edition, stirs again — The Wind Hills changed hands through the evening, though Warden banners there still number twelve. The Weathered Expanse remains the war's furnace: fifty-four flag movements in a day, Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch and Necropolis the busiest grounds, and the Warden count slips to four posts with four more laid in ruin. Linn Mercy's toll stays heavy at Outwich Ranch and Lathair; Marban Hollow grinds on at Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, its bases split three ways. Callahans Passage raises no flag, yet its casualty lists climb toward two thousand an hour between the armies. Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf, stirring at our last writing, have gone quiet, and Kuura Strand rests under the Colonial flag. It is day 724; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is declared.
